name: Common bed
function: Provides the common mounting base for the generator set.
maintenance: Inspect mounting bolts, alignment and foundation condition.

name: Flywheel cover
maintenance: Inspect guards and fasteners before operation.

name: Generator
function: Converts mechanical rotation into electrical energy.
maintenance: Inspect terminals, bearings and insulation condition.

name: Level switch
function: Monitors a fluid level and provides a status signal.
location: Mounted on associated tank or system
maintenance: Test operation and inspect electrical connections.

name: LO priming pump
function: Supplies lubricating oil before or during engine operation.
maintenance: Inspect pump condition, connections and priming flow.

name: Turning device
function: Rotates the engine slowly for maintenance and preparation.
maintenance: Verify interlock and gear engagement before use.
